  "steps": {
    "0": "START",
    "1": "Discard-Discard ends of the tortilla",
    "2": "slicing-Continue slicing with floss to create 1 more pinwheel",
    "3": "Clean-Clean the knife by wiping with a paper towel",
    "4": "Cross-Cross the floss's two ends over the tortilla roll's top",
    "5": "Slide-Slide floss under the tortilla, perpendicular to the length of the roll",
    "6": "Spread-Spread jelly over the nut butter",
    "7": "pull-pull the floss ends in opposite directions to slice",
    "8": "Place-Place the pinwheels on a plate",
    "9": "Secure-Secure the rolled tortilla by inserting 5 toothpicks about 1 inch apart",
    "10": "scoop-Use the knife to scoop jelly from the jar",
    "11": "Spread-Spread nut butter onto the tortilla, leaving 1/2-inch uncovered at the edges",
    "12": "scoop-Use a butter knife to scoop nut butter from the jar",
    "13": "Trim-Trim the ends of the tortilla roll with the butter knife, leaving 1/2 inch margin between the last toothpick and the end of the roll",
    "14": "Place-Place 8-inch flour tortilla on cutting board",
    "15": "Roll-Roll the tortilla from one end to the other into a log shape, about 1.5 inches thick. Roll it tight enough to prevent gaps, but not so tight that the filling leaks",
    "16": "Place-Place the floss halfway between toothpicks",
    "17": "Clean-Clean the knife by wiping it with a paper towel",
    "18": "END"
